headline: Last session: Indian markets closed for the weekend while news focuses on HDFC Bank's upcoming UPI SMS changes.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 1 December.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, 28 November 2026, due to the weekend.
No live trading is taking place on the NSE or BSE during Saturday.
Investors are reviewing individual corporate updates and personal finance trends over the non-trading days.
HDFC Bank announced policy changes regarding SMS notifications for low-value UPI transactions.
whatHappening: HDFC Bank announced that starting January, customers will no longer receive SMS alerts for UPI payments of Rs 200.
Recent news highlights personal finance issues, including severe debt cycles from trading losses and bad loan decisions.
Media updates over the weekend largely cover non-market, general news, sports, and entertainment topics.
Markets are scheduled to reopen for trading after the weekend break.
summary:
Indian equity markets are closed today for the weekend break.
HDFC Bank reported that customers will stop receiving SMS notifications for Rs 200 UPI transactions starting January.
Trading activity will resume in the next scheduled market session.
